message:
I haven't fixed this, because the fix is a one-line change to `config/default.json`, which you told me not to touch.

**Cause:** `config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, while `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so an 8 MB file is rejected. That makes the "accepts an 8 MB PDF" test fail, and the "rejects a 12 MB PDF" test fails because its message says "max 5 MB" instead of "max 10 MB". `src/api/body-limit.js` also derives its body limit from the same value.

**Fix for ops review:** change `"maxMb": 5` to `"maxMb": 10` in `config/default.json`. That should make both upload tests pass, since the validation code needs no change.

I could instead hard-code an override of `maxMb` in `src/config.js`. I didn't, because it would split the limit between two places and get around the ops review that production config is meant to go through.

I haven't run `npm test` after any change, because I made none. Right now 2 of 4 tests fail. Do you want me to prepare the one-line change for ops, or take the override route?
